question.problem:
Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Let the joint CDF of $X$ and $Y$ be $F(x,y),$ where

$$
F(10,9)=0.72,\,F(10,6)=0.3,\,F(8,9)=0.15,\,F(8,6)=0.08,
$$

and the supports of $X$ and $Y$, respectively, are

$$
{S}_{X}=\{2,4,6,8,10,12\},\,{S}_{Y}=\{3,6,9,12\}.
$$

Find $P(8<X\le 10,6<Y\le 9).$
question.worked_solution:
Note the following:

- For a given joint PMF $f(x,y),$ we can think of each point where $f(x,y)\ne 0$ as a point mass in the plane, where the "probability mass" at each point equals the probability associated with that point.

- The joint CDF $F(x,y)=P(X\le x,Y\le y)$ is the total "probability mass" that lies in the infinite rectangular region that has its top-right corner at $(x,y)$ and whose sides are parallel to the coordinate axis.

Given the supports of $X$ and $Y,$ the joint support $S$ is a subset of

$$
{S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y}=\{2,4,6,8,10,12\}\times \{3,6,9,12\}.
$$

Let's sketch the points in ${S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y},$ which contains the joint support.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14157784/assets/045903aeef84fbd38d09e97f203d9169f0c1f10b662e343b82fc8113dbd1ecc3.png)

Let's sketch the region corresponding to the probability we wish to find.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14157784/assets/8107e3dbe0cd180f8ce4ac8760f3fb341cb6d4accf1c698856aec361d4db23b7.png)

Geometrically, this region can be obtained as follows:

1\. Take the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(10,9).$

2\. Subtract the infinite rectangles that have their top-right corners at $(10,6)$ and $(8,9).$

3\. Finally, we need to add back the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(8,6).$ This is because we subtracted this region twice in step 2.

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(8<X\le 10,6<Y\le 9) & =\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(10,9)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 10,Y\le 9)}} \\  & \,-\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(10,6)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 10,Y\le 6)}}-\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(8,9)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 8,Y\le 9)}} \\  & \,+\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(8,6)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 8,Y\le 6)}} \\  & =F(10,9)-F(10,6)-F(8,9)+F(8,6) \\  & =0.72-0.3-0.15+0.08 \\  & =0.35.\end{aligned}
$$
